mods.name: Change Deck On Load
mods.author: Twisted / twistedmind-afk
mods.summary: Select the target deck after LOAD, or load the highlighted track with SELECT.
mods.description: Automatically select a deck after loading a track, or load the highlighted track with its SELECT button in the track list. Two independent switches; use either or both.

mods.name: LED Blink On Air
mods.author: Twisted / twistedmind-afk
mods.summary: Independently blink deck LOAD and SELECT LEDs while ON AIR.
mods.description: Blink LOAD and SELECT LEDs twice per second while a deck is ON AIR. Each group can be enabled independently. Selected decks blink bright/dim; unselected decks blink dim/off.

mods.name: 4 Deck Pro DJ Link Plus
mods.author: Twisted / twistedmind-afk
mods.summary: Four internal LINK decks, original 2+2 or selectable 3+1 with external Deck 3 or 4.
mods.description: Four internal LINK decks, original 2+2 or selectable 3+1 with external Deck 3 or 4. Includes a build-specific Compact Track Info playhead compatibility fix through the normal SDK. Other Core builds remain untouched; see the README for the Center -> BROWSE -> Left workaround.
